Next-Door Neighbors

Back to quest database

Meet Gigi and Scott, with watering-can and hoe checks for the farming introduction.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Work through the objectives

  1. Meet Gigi and hold at least one Bronze Watering Can.
  2. Meet Scott and hold at least one Bronze Hoe.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • Conversation alone is not the entire configured condition: each meeting also checks its corresponding tool.
  • The success configuration continues to Seeds of Success.

  • After Scott’s quest dialogue： Hoe × 1 · Bronze
